scheduledEvents.title: Finnish Civil War Begins
scheduledEvents.description: The Finnish Civil War erupts as the Finnish Socialist Workers' Republic (Red Guards) seizes control of southern Finland.

scheduledEvents.title: Crimean People's Republic Declared
scheduledEvents.description: The Crimean Tatar National Assembly (Kurultay) proclaims the Crimean People's Republic, the first democratic republic in the Muslim world.

scheduledEvents.title: Moldavian Democratic Republic Established
scheduledEvents.description: The Sfatul Tarii proclaims the Moldavian Democratic Republic in Bessarabia, aligned under White Army protection.

scheduledEvents.title: Moldavia Declares Independence
scheduledEvents.description: The Moldavian Democratic Republic declares independence, ending its protectorate relationship with the White Army.

scheduledEvents.title: Donetsk–Krivoy Rog Soviet Republic Declared
scheduledEvents.description: The Donetsk–Krivoy Rog Soviet Republic is proclaimed as an independent Soviet republic, encompassing the industrial Donbass and Krivoy Rog regions under Bolshevik control.

scheduledEvents.title: Stavropol Soviet Republic Proclaimed
scheduledEvents.description: Bolshevik forces seize control of Stavropol, proclaiming the Stavropol Soviet Republic as a revolutionary government under Soviet Russian patronage.

scheduledEvents.title: Kuban People's Republic Established
scheduledEvents.description: The Kuban Rada proclaims the Kuban People's Republic, establishing an independent Cossack state under the protection of the Volunteer Army (White Army).

scheduledEvents.title: Treaty of Brest-Litovsk (Ukraine)
scheduledEvents.description: The Central Powers sign a separate peace treaty with the Ukrainian People's Republic. Germany and Ukraine grant each other military access, and Germany declares war on Soviet Russia to enforce the treaty.

scheduledEvents.title: Treaty of Brest-Litovsk
scheduledEvents.description: Soviet Russia signs the Treaty of Brest-Litovsk with the Central Powers, renouncing its revolutionary client ties in Ukraine and ending the war with Germany and its puppet states.

scheduledEvents.title: Odessa Soviet Republic Proclaimed
scheduledEvents.description: Bolshevik forces establish control over Odessa and the surrounding region, proclaiming the Odessa Soviet Republic as a revolutionary Soviet state.
